patterns.note: Full-bleed, edge-to-edge imagery and video sections dominate the page, often serving as hero areas for large typographic statements that span the full viewport width.
Overlapping, oversized sans-serif typography is used as a primary visual element, often interacting with background imagery through parallax and serving as section titles.
A stark black and white base palette is consistently contrasted with vibrant, often pastel or muted, colors introduced through product photography and occasional brand accents.
Large, bold text elements parallax over full-bleed image or video backgrounds as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic, layered effect where text appears to float over the content.

The homepage is structured as a series of distinct, full-screen or near-full-screen visual modules, each featuring a hero image/video and a prominent typographic statement, which transition smoothly into one another upon scroll.

technique_notes: The site employs a custom scroll experience, likely using a library like Locomotive Scroll, to create smooth scrolling and sophisticated parallax effects. Large, bold text elements are positioned to scroll at a different rate than their full-bleed image or video backgrounds, creating a layered depth effect.
Full-width, full-height hero sections are used to introduce content blocks, featuring dynamic video or high-resolution photography with large, overlaid typographic statements.
A minimalist, fixed header navigation remains visible at the top, providing persistent access to main categories while the main content scrolls beneath it.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-6x body text) create strong visual impact, balanced by a clean, legible sans-serif for body and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, from image frames to buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: An airy and expansive spacing is used in hero sections and between major content blocks, transitioning to a more balanced density within product grids and informational footers.

standout: The site's distinctive use of monumental, overlapping typography that interacts dynamically with full-bleed, often video-based, backgrounds through a sophisticated parallax scroll effect. This creates a highly immersive and editorial feel, making the text itself a central design element rather than just content.
